degradations.detail: Maven build failed; the dependency tree fell back to the pom.xml declarations.

findings.name: Dependency graph covers less than half of the components
findings.description: More than 50% of the components with a bom-ref appear nowhere in dependencies[] - neither as a graph node nor as a dependsOn target - which means the resolver or lockfile that would have connected them did not run.
findings.message: Only 0 of 3 components appear in the dependency graph (100% uncovered); the BOM reads like a flat list of declarations
findings.mitigation: Run the ecosystem resolver before generating the BOM (or let cdxgen --install-deps drive it) so transitive edges are captured, then re-scan

findings.name: Maven components with no dependency entries
findings.description: pkg:maven components exist but no dependency graph node references any of them, which is the pom.xml fallback shape: only declared dependencies were captured and the resolver never ran.
findings.message: 3 pkg:maven components were captured with no dependency graph, so only declared dependencies are present
findings.mitigation: Build the project with `mvn package -Dmaven.test.skip=true` (or `gradle build`) using the correct JDK before invoking cdxgen so the dependency tree is resolved
